sourcesNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on every name, description and grade. Guides are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources beside each trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically — there is nothing extra to do. Treat it as a progress marker, not a task: the roadmap below orders the other 54. No online play is needed; all 55 trophies are single-player.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and this pops at its end. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — just play the opening. If it has not popped, the mission is not yet complete.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies pop as you play; chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene, so keep playing if it lags. Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it feeds the missable Positive Mental Attitude.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens during this chapter, which unlocks most partner and free-roam trophies. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun arrive in this chapter, and a time-sensitive race in Yago's street-racing strand appears here — save before racing it. Keep a manual save at the chapter start.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault jobs unlock near the end of this chapter through an optional mission, so do that mission before the finale if you want the robbery trophies early. Keep a manual save at the chapter start and one before the final mission.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, so do not rush side content before the finale unless you want it done. Keep an untouched save from just before the final mission.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies are unmissable: play the story in order and it pops when the mission ends. There is no mission replay, so a missed optional objective inside the mission cannot be redone — but the trophy only needs the mission complete.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Same as the other mission trophies: finish the mission and it pops. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed on a playthrough that reaches it.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Unmissable story trophy — finish the mission and it pops.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Unmissable story trophy — finish the mission and it pops.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable story trophy — finish the mission at Vice City International Airport.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story trophy — finish the mission and it pops.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked in-game under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but that checklist only appears after the story, while work done earlier still counts. The checklist is the long grind: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations, among others. Do the story first, then clean up with the checklist visible.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250. Stunts are free-roam, so chip away at them whenever you travel.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample everything the game offers — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races and the rest — rather than grinding one. Check the in-game activity list if you are unsure which types you have tried.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — two ranges hold 42 gold medals between them. This is the skill gate of the list: learn each range's scoring, then repeat until gold. It is not missable; the ranges stay open after the story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations are reported. Win at least one race at each spot; you do not need to win every race, just one per location. Drone races are free-roam activities, available after the story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different races, not the same one 20 times. Mix street races, drone races and any other race types; each new race you win ticks the count. Yago's street-racing strand in Chapter 3 is a good place to start, and one of its races is time-sensitive, so save first.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take his fishing challenge, and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine, not just start one. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; pick a game and see it through to its end.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is a strangers strand: follow his missions to their end. Strands like Andy's do not count toward Strangers & Freaks — that trophy tracks other strands — but Andy's own finale has its own trophy. Side-story finales stay open after the main story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush — but finish the strand, not just its early missions.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission. Like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies — so check the trophy's own progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand race, Race Against Yago in Chapter 3, is time-sensitive (hourglass icon): save before it and race the moment it appears.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission; it stays open after the story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission; it stays open after the story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — and start in Chapter 1. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close; bring your partner, since each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (after she is home — check the kitchen in the morning, often the morning after Down to Earth) disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Do it, and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that one spot, so do it anyway.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. Follow Bret's strand until a unique-animal hunt completes.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are a collectible: gather full sets, three of them, to pop this. Track your sets on the collection screen and sweep areas you have not fully explored.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to tag 100 different spots as you travel — scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts toward discovering them, so tag as you drive. It is a cumulative count across the whole map.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges; 100% needs 70 of the 80, so this pops on the way. Many complete on their own while you play — check the list for the ones you can finish deliberately.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bring your partner, earn 4 stars (bank vault jobs give 4 stars straight away), then lose the cops and leave the red heat zone — the trophy pops once you are clear, not just out of the flashing search area. Vault jobs near the end of Chapter 4 are the reliable setup.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so wait before hitting a fourth.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models — keep scanning past 100.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 and R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, use an assault rifle, and drop five before Focus ends. Adrenaline extends Focus.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count; gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km from the airport and it pops. Save first — the police come fast.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos: get into a military tank. Tanks are reported parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. The exact spawn is launch-week reporting, not yet confirmed in play.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if anyone spots you, reload rather than push on.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Each vault job gives 4 stars straight away, so escaping with your partner also feeds Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored truck, take it, and escape the heat — the trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone. Vault jobs and truck robberies share the same escape rule.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover the whole map — every region counts, so drive, fly and sail into corners you have not visited. The in-game map shades explored areas; sweep the edges and the islands last.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation from each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way. Operations are the gang-run fronts around the map; vary your targets until every gang is ticked.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront spot and enjoy the view — the trophy's description is the whole instruction, and no confirmed step-by-step exists yet. Try a bar with an ocean view; if it does not pop, it may need a specific venue, which launch-week reports have not yet pinned down.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's glass front — the description points at a showroom smash-and-grab exit, not a quiet purchase. The exact showroom and trigger are not yet confirmed in play; the description is the only confirmed fact, so try a big showroom and drive out through the front.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe's contents, blown open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner — the partner trains alongside you. Max both characters' Strength at the gym; the trophy should pop when the second one maxes out.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse): 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — keep playing the criminal life and check the profile counter. The 500 figure is single-source launch reporting, not yet confirmed in play.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: the description is a riddle with no confirmed method yet. It is a hidden trophy whose trigger launch-week reports have not pinned down — the name hints at failing something once and succeeding on the retry. Do not chase it blindly; play normally and check updated reports before grinding it.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Another hidden trophy with no confirmed unlock method at launch — the name hints at a strange encounter or event somewhere in Leonida. No reliable method is published yet; the description is the only confirmed fact.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The method is still being confirmed at launch — the name points at a melee attack from a moving vehicle, likely near a bowling alley. No confirmed step-by-step exists yet; treat it as unconfirmed and check updated reports.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so bank jobs feed it steadily.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, food, weapons, anything. It adds up naturally over a full playthrough; late-game purchases finish it off.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver — together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count; only bought ones do.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
